charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1101_0100:
After finishing a Pokémon battle,
[Name:PlayerNickname ] was approached
by Tabitha.
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_0200: Ahyahya! You fought rather splendidly, child!
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_0300:
You must raise your Pokémon with
great care.
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_0400: My Camerupt will not fall behind!
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_0500:
I, Tabitha—a Team Magma admin—raised
this Camerupt, which makes him unique!
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_0401_0700: Good grief. Children, am I right?
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_0402_0900: Hyuhn?! Is something wrong with your eyes?!
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_1000:
How can you not understand how an adult
sees it?!
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_1200:
His fur is glossy! His body is the epitome
of health! He is completely different from
the others!
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_1300:
By carefully preparing his meals and
planning his training...
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_1400:
I have helped a simple Camerupt grow
splendidly, so much so that it is like no other!
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_1500:
Furthermore! Combine that with my superb
intellect...
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_1600:
and according to my calculations, you get
the strongest sync pair!
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_1800:
To us Team Magma members, Camerupt and
its previous Evolution, Numel...
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_1900:
provide great help outside of battle by
transporting our things.
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_2000:
It’s a strong Pokémon that goes unnoticed in
how foundationally it supports Team Magma.
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_2100:
As the brains of the organization, I feel a
strong affinity with it.
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_2200:
Now then, child. You must be glad THE
Tabitha graced you with a conversation!
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_2300:
Should you come to understand the pains
and differences adults face...
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_2400:
I wouldn’t mind if you came to see my
Camerupt again.
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_2500:
When that time arrives, I will give you some
very thorough coaching on how to raise
Pokémon.
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_2600:
After all, I, Tabitha, guide not only Team
Magma’s Pokémon but also the grunts.
charaepi_ch0221_00_homura/2301_1201_2700: I am confident in my training techniques!
